scope: Public Tier 0 Tensor/device execution primitives and Tier 1 training-critical computation/lifecycle APIs
oracle_policy: PyTorch is primary for numerical and training semantics; deterministic contract tests cover engine-only execution and lifecycle truth.

entries.operation: construction, copy/move, clone, dtype and metadata
entries.contract: Checked shape/byte ownership with stable dtype, logical shape, copy and move semantics.
entries.supported: rank 0-4 ArrayFire tensors; Float32, Float64, Int32, Int64, UInt8
entries.oracle: PyTorch tensor construction plus engine ownership invariants
entries.execution: host ingress or ArrayFire-resident construction

entries.operation: ReadData, MutableData and compatibility Data host boundaries
entries.contract: ReadData preserves device state; MutableData invalidates device state; successful guarded compute must not use Data.
entries.supported: all Tensor dtypes
entries.oracle: engine ownership and host-sync trace contract
entries.execution: exact source inventory distinguishes compatibility compute from explicit host, transport and selected-native-backend ownership
gaps: 47 reviewed legacy Data-access files remain: 31 compatibility-compute owners and 16 explicit host, transport or selected-native-backend owners

entries.operation: GetSemanticArray, SetFromSemanticArray and rank-aware ArrayFire layout conversion
entries.contract: Logical row-major rank-2/rank-3 semantics are preserved without device-to-host conversion.
entries.supported: rank 1-4; explicit semantic adapters for rank 2 and 3
entries.oracle: PyTorch logical layout plus zero-host-sync trace
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device

entries.operation: reshape, view, squeeze, unsqueeze and flatten
entries.contract: Element order and count match PyTorch; invalid dimensions and products fail before compute.
entries.supported: public Tensor rank and dtype domain
entries.execution: ArrayFire-first where device-current

entries.operation: transpose and permute
entries.contract: Logical dimensions and row-major values match PyTorch.
entries.supported: rank 0-4 and all Tensor dtypes on ArrayFire; explicit compatibility fallback above rank 4
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device through rank 4; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4

entries.operation: At/Set typed indexing, Slice and IndexSelect
entries.contract: Positive and negative dimensions, positive slice steps, clamped bounds, empty outputs and selected value order match PyTorch; IndexSelect additionally preserves the declared CyxWiz negative-index extension after normalization.
entries.supported: rank 1-4 Slice/IndexSelect for all Tensor dtypes on ArrayFire; rank 1-4 typed scalar access; explicit compatibility fallback above rank 4
entries.oracle: PyTorch 2.10 plus explicit CyxWiz negative-IndexSelect and bounded scalar-access contracts
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device Slice/IndexSelect through rank 4; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4; bounded At/Set are explicit host boundaries

entries.operation: Cat, Stack, Split and Chunk
entries.contract: Positive and negative axes, row-major ordering, scalar stack, PyTorch (0,) Cat identity, zero-sized split sections, empty dimensions, partial final chunks and invalid shapes match PyTorch within the declared same-dtype domain.
entries.supported: all Tensor dtypes: Cat ranks 1-4, Stack input ranks 0-3, and Split/Chunk ranks 1-4 on ArrayFire; explicit compatibility fallback for higher output ranks
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device Cat/Stack through output rank 4; Split/Chunk delegate to resident Slice; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4

entries.operation: Sum, Mean, Max, Min, Prod, Var and Std; global and axis reductions
entries.contract: Global and axis shape, negative dimensions, keepdim, correction, dtype, empty and invalid-domain behavior match the selected PyTorch semantic variant.
entries.supported: all public Tensor dtypes at ranks 0-4 on ArrayFire; explicit compatibility fallback for ranks above 4
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device reductions through rank 4 with zero compute host sync; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4 and pre-compute rejection in strict mode

entries.operation: tensor/scalar arithmetic, Pow, Sqrt, Exp, Log, Abs, Sign, Clip and negation
entries.contract: Broadcasting, dtype, finite/extreme behavior and element order match PyTorch within declared tolerance.
entries.supported: Float32, Float64, Int32, Int64 and UInt8 across public arithmetic and unary APIs; ArrayFire ranks 0-4 and declared rank-above-4 native compatibility
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device through rank 4 with zero compute host sync; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4 and pre-compute rejection in strict mode

entries.operation: comparisons and logical operators
entries.contract: Right-aligned broadcasting, promoted comparison dtype, scalar weak-float semantics, zero/non-zero truth and UInt8 mask values match PyTorch.
entries.supported: Float32, Float64, Int32, Int64 and UInt8 tensor comparisons/logical operators across ranks 0-4 on ArrayFire; scalar comparisons for every public dtype; explicit rank-above-4 native compatibility
entries.oracle: PyTorch 2.10 with explicit UInt8 result adaptation
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device through rank 4 with zero compute host sync; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4 and pre-compute rejection in strict mode

entries.operation: IsBroadcastable, BroadcastShape, BroadcastTo and Expand
entries.contract: Symmetric right-aligned shape inference, concrete-target Expand/BroadcastTo values, zero dimensions, identity/leading-rank materialization, and invalid-shape rejection match PyTorch.
entries.supported: IsBroadcastable/BroadcastShape across public ranks; Float32, Float64, Int32, Int64 and UInt8 Expand/BroadcastTo at ranks 0-4 on ArrayFire; explicit non-empty rank-above-4 native compatibility
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-to-device materialization through rank 4 with zero compute host sync; empty outputs require no compute; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4 and pre-compute rejection in strict mode

entries.operation: Zeros, Ones, Random, RandomSeeded and RangeN
entries.contract: Zeros, Ones and RangeN shape/dtype/value semantics match PyTorch; Random follows the declared CyxWiz dtype ranges and PyTorch uniform-distribution concepts; RandomSeeded exactly replays for a fixed seed, shape, dtype, backend and device without mutating global RNG state.
entries.supported: all Tensor dtypes and public ranks; scalar, zero-size and trailing-singleton shapes are exact; ranks 0-4 execute on ArrayFire and non-empty ranks above 4 use declared native compatibility
entries.oracle: PyTorch 2.10 exact factory semantics and uniform-distribution concepts plus CyxWiz deterministic replay and integer random extensions
entries.execution: ArrayFire device-resident creation through rank 4 with zero compute host sync; empty outputs require no compute; declared native CPU compatibility fallback above rank 4 and pre-compute rejection in strict mode

entries.operation: Dot and BatchMatMul
entries.contract: Vector Dot preserves the declared CyxWiz shape [1] while matching torch.dot values; rank-2 Dot is the declared row-wise (left * right).sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) extension; BatchMatMul matches torch.bmm rank-3 axes and rejects batch broadcasting. Shapes, dtypes, fractional floating values, integer values, zero-size identities and invalid inputs are exact.
entries.supported: all Tensor dtypes; rank-1/rank-2 same-shape Dot and equal-batch rank-3 BatchMatMul, including zero batch/rows/columns/shared dimensions
entries.oracle: PyTorch 2.10 plus explicit CyxWiz Dot output-shape and row-wise extensions
entries.execution: Dot is ArrayFire device-resident for every Tensor dtype; Float32/Float64 BatchMatMul is ArrayFire device-resident; integer BatchMatMul records unsupported_dtype and uses declared native CPU compatibility only when fallback policy permits; empty/zero-shared identities require no fallback

entries.operation: device discovery and exact activation
entries.contract: Requested and effective backend/device remain distinct; exact activation validates execution and never relabels another backend.
entries.supported: ArrayFire CPU and locally qualified CUDA/OpenCL/oneAPI routes; unavailable or ineligible optional routes produce an explicit skip
entries.oracle: ArrayFire runtime identity plus engine contract
entries.execution: runtime selection transaction with qualification, exact activation, process-route restoration, identity revalidation and atomic next-run commit

entries.operation: ExecutionDeviceContext capture, immutable bind and active-run mutation gate
entries.contract: One context is bound before compute and preserves requested/effective identity, generation and fallback policy for the run.
entries.supported: Engine ArrayFire runs
entries.execution: run-scoped control plane with a shared execution lease and fail-closed device-selection mutation gate

entries.operation: native CPU fallback compatibility and strict policies
entries.contract: Every attempt records operation/reason/backend/context/policy; strict mode rejects before native compute; ArrayFire CPU is not native fallback.
entries.supported: declared compatibility gaps only
entries.execution: observed compatibility boundary plus exact reviewed legacy-access ownership inventory
gaps: migrate or explicitly guard the 31 inventoried compatibility-compute files that still use legacy Tensor Data access

entries.operation: host synchronization attribution and bounded output
entries.contract: Every device-to-host materialization has category, operation, shape, dtype, layout, backend and byte count.
entries.supported: instrumented Tensor host materialization
entries.execution: Tensor and non-Tensor ArrayFire host materialization use attributed boundaries; repository source scan rejects unaudited direct host calls; trace groups reconcile exactly with run counts and bytes

entries.operation: Linear with bias, float32 forward/input-gradient/mean parameter-gradient
entries.contract: Forward is input @ weight^T + bias; input and parameter gradients match PyTorch autograd, including sum-over-batch weight/bias gradients.
entries.supported: rank-1/rank-2 Float32, optional bias
entries.oracle: PyTorch fixture with explicit CyxWiz parameter-gradient reduction
entries.execution: ArrayFire-first; strict ArrayFire CPU and every selectable installed CUDA/OpenCL route prove biased/unbiased rank-1/rank-2 forward/backward and two-step multi-batch SGD updates with exact route identity, no native fallback and bounded attributed verification readback
gaps: process-isolated oneAPI Linear qualification; known-bad oneAPI device 0 must remain quarantined

entries.operation: Dense wrapper forward/backward and activation composition
entries.contract: Dense preserves Linear parameter semantics and applies the configured activation exactly once.
entries.supported: Float32 configurations exposed by DenseLayer
entries.execution: ArrayFire-first where component operations support it

entries.operation: FlattenLayer and FlattenModule forward/backward
entries.contract: Forward matches torch.nn.Flatten without value reordering; backward accepts only the exact cached output shape/dtype and restores the cached input shape.
entries.supported: rank >= 2, configured start_dim through the final dimension, and Float32/Float64/Int32/Int64/UInt8 payload preservation
entries.execution: strict ArrayFire-resident cross-rank reshape with zero native fallback or host synchronization on ArrayFire CPU, every installed CUDA/OpenCL device, and oneAPI device 1; oneAPI device 0 is rejected through the isolated route-qualification boundary
gaps: installed oneAPI device 0 provider/runtime repair: igc64.dll raises access violation 0xC0000005 during device input creation; rerun isolated qualification after driver/plugin update

entries.operation: DropoutLayer and DropoutModule training and evaluation modes
entries.contract: Probability is inclusive [0,1]; evaluation and p=0 are exact identity; p=1 is exact zero; Float32 training applies inverted-dropout scaling and backward reuses the mask owned by the successful training forward even if the current mode changes.
entries.supported: all Tensor dtypes for identity paths; Float32 for stochastic training
entries.oracle: Generated PyTorch 2.10 forward/backward boundary and distribution fixtures plus same-backend CyxWiz seed replay
entries.execution: strict ArrayFire-resident CPU, CUDA, OpenCL and qualified oneAPI routes; declared native CPU compatibility fallback
gaps: installed oneAPI device 0 Intel provider/runtime repair and exact-route requalification

entries.operation: ReLU, LeakyReLU, ELU, GELU, Swish/SiLU, Sigmoid, Tanh, Mish, Hardswish and SELU forward/backward
entries.contract: Forward and analytical input gradient match the corresponding PyTorch operation, including boundary points and finite extremes.

entries.execution: strict ArrayFire-resident CPU, CUDA and OpenCL routes; declared native CPU compatibility fallback
